Long live Laura-sama, mo! Long live
Adel-sama, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_04_msg0002
rows.name:
On behalf of the Pignerator
Trade Guild chairman, Momimi
offers big congratulations, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_04_msg0003
rows.name:
And speaking of celebrations, this
vase has a proud history and a strange
power that brings happiness, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Mo? Too suspicious, so you don't want
it? Mo-mo~ You're not being honest,
mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_04_msg0005
rows.name:
People have always said, 'Happiness
doesn't come walking, so buy a vase,
mo.'

rows.label: tlk70000033_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Now then, Knight-sama and friends! Buy
this vase and rise to even greater...

rows.label: tlk70000033_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Mo?! Don't look at Momimi like that!
It was a joke, mo! Momimi just wanted
to say congratulations, mooo!
